changelog:
Initial release of Local Model Router

- Routes simple and medium complexity queries to local Ollama models to reduce DeepSeek cloud API cost.
- Provides model selection logic for different query types (chitchat, coding, logic, embeddings, etc.).
- Details local and cloud model usage scenarios, fallback logic, and example API calls.
- Explains cost comparison and key limitations (tool use, large context, up-to-date information).
- Major cleanup: removed previous tech news digest sources, scripts, and configuration files.
